Igushik River MCMC Output (Brood Years 1963-2005)

Source: R/data-docs.R
post_Igushik_byr63_05.Rd

A named list of posterior samples from a stock-recruitment model fit to Igushik River brood years 1963-2005. Each row represents one MCMC sample and contains primary parameter nodes used by downstream functions such as get_profile(), plot_SR(), and Optimal Yield Profile calculations.

post_Igushik_byr63_05

Format

A data frame with one row per MCMC draw and columns:

beta

Density dependence parameter.

deviance

Deviance measure used for MCMC diagnostics.

e0

Initial 'residual' for autoregressive model.

lnalpha

Log-scale productivity parameter.

phi

Temporal autocorrelation parameter.

sigma

Process or observation error standard deviation.

Source

Igushik River stock-recruit model (brood years 1963-2005).

Details

Posterior samples are used to generate stock-recruit curves, calculate SMSY, and derive Optimal Yield Profiles (OYP).

Examples

head(post_Igushik_byr63_05)
